content:
Hi folks! Just a reminder that our inaugural meeting for the Internationalization WG 2.0 is today at 10 AM eastern time (in like 15 minutes)! All are welcome to join! I'm really excited to get this working group back up and I think it's a great opportunity to connect.

Meeting info is here: https://www.gdcc.io/working-groups/internationalization.html

Don't hesitate to reach out! If you can't make the meeting this month, we will also meet on December 4th!
@Alyssa Conlon great meeting! I need to learn from you to end a bit early! :sweat_smile:
For anyone who missed it, here are the slides and notes.
I'll post the recording of the meeting soon!
Sry to have missed this. Too much other work to do!
I would have brought up #internationalization > tools @ 💬 :see_no_evil: From the notes it doesn't look like y'all discussed that.
This first meeting was general but I think we could talk about tools at the next one in December, highlight the one you shared in the other thread and gather some other ones to discuss?
